Identified root causes of AI degradation using statistical techniques

Wrote over 5000 lines of modular and extensible Python code

work.name: Wells Fargo
work.summary: Built an AI-powered transcription tool for visually impaired employees.
highlights: Improved transcription speed by 1.3x and accuracy by 40%
Deployed solution impacting 15,000+ visually impaired staff

awards.title: 1st Runners Up at the annual Threesis Academic Challenge in NYU GSAS
awards.awarder: NYU Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
awards.summary: Presented my ongoing research regarding post-deployment evaluation of AI tools in a short three minute talk titled The curious case of the aging AI doctor in front of a non-technical audience. My aim was to throw light on the perils of relying of short-term accuracy of AI tools deployed in hospitals and involved in critical clinical decision making and how our team at NYU Langone Health is trying to solve this issue by benchmarking models and developing real-time monitoring tools. My talk made it to the final round among 70 graduate presentations from NYU GSAS and I received the first runners up prize in the final round with a net prize of $1300.
